//: Vite transpiles TS itself, so tsc is used only as a type checker (noEmit).
`npm run typecheck` is the CI gate; `vite build` does not type-check.
strict and allowJs:false are enabled here rather than in
tsconfig.base.json because the base is shared with desktop/, which has
not been assessed. server/ sets the same flags in its own config.
allowJs:false is safe even though .test.js/.test.jsx files still exist
under src/ — 'include' matches them, but with allowJs off tsc silently
excludes .js/.jsx from the program instead of erroring, and Vitest
